props.gloss_en: (the mishnah, cited) a long passage is read by two, at shacharit and at musaf; and at mincha they read by heart
(asked) at shacharit and at musaf they read it from the scroll, and at mincha by heart as one reads Shema?
or perhaps it teaches: at shacharit from the scroll, and at musaf and mincha by heart as one reads Shema?
at shacharit and at musaf they enter the synagogue and read in the way they read all year
and at mincha an individual reads it by heart
R' Yosei: can an individual read words of Torah by heart before the community?
rather, all of them enter and read it by heart, as one reads Shema
